body:
Still reproduces on **1.9** (main @ bbac9b2b), Pixel 7a / Android 17. A portrait photo taken from **Add Item → Take photo** shows up rotated 90° clockwise in the Add Item preview, and the saved item image is rotated too.

## Root cause: EXIF rotation is applied twice
#239 (e63dd7d2, "fix all deprecation warnings") replaced `MediaStore.Images.Media.getBitmap()` with `getBitmapCompat()` (`util/ImageUtil.kt`). On API 28+, that uses `ImageDecoder.decodeBitmap()`, which **already applies the EXIF orientation** when decoding.

`ImageHandler.updateImagePreview()` then passes that already-upright bitmap to `correctImageRotation()`, which reads the same EXIF tag and rotates it again. A portrait camera photo has `ORIENTATION_ROTATE_90`, so it ends up rotated 90° clockwise. Landscape shots with `ORIENTATION_NORMAL` look fine, which is why this seems intermittent.

`ItemEntryActivity.saveImageIfNeeded()` saves `imageHandler.correctedBitmap`, so the wrong rotation is also written to disk and shows in the items list.

## Fix
Rotate only once. Either drop `correctImageRotation()` on the `ImageDecoder` path, or keep the manual EXIF step only for the pre-P `MediaStore` path. Gallery picks go through the same code, so they should be checked too.

## Side note from the logcat
`ImageHandler.takePicture()` (line 189) triggers *"Implicit URI read/write grant for ImageCapture action will be discontinued from Android 18 onwards. Please set the grant explicitly in the app."* The `TakePicture` intent should set `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION` explicitly, or camera capture may break on Android 18.
